solvefx.title: Stop 1: The Hostel
solvefx.say: The hostel. 2 AM. This is where LeetCode verdicts started to need a soundtrack.

ipl-auction.title: Stop 2: Cricket Ground
ipl-auction.say: The tallest thing I've shipped: 140 commits of auction chaos.

repomind-ai.title: Stop 3: Tech Street
repomind-ai.say: Codebases rot slowly. This one catches the moment it starts.

clipper.title: Stop 4: Film Market
clipper.say: A video clipper that runs on my own laptop, once it stopped lying to me.

mimic-hunt.title: Stop 5: The Mansion
mimic-hunt.say: Careful in here. The furniture might be a person.

verdict.brief: It's 2 AM, and it's Two Sum. Pick a solution and press Submit.

solutions.label: Two loops
Sort first
solutions.code:
a.sort()
i, j = 0, n - 1
while a[i] + a[j] != t:
  i, j = next(i, j)
return [i, j]

tle.title: Time limit exceeded
tle.body: SolveFX gives this one a fake system shutdown. Try another.

wrong.title: Wrong answer
wrong.body: Sorting loses the original indexes. SolveFX has a special screen for moments like this. Try another.

accepted.title: Accepted
accepted.body: Every verdict gets its own overlay and sound. That's the entire extension, and I'm very proud of it.

auction.brief: You're bidding for me. Three rival franchises want me too, and you have 20 seconds.
auction.won: Sold to you! The real game has 323 players, and 9 AI franchises that bid much better than these three.
auction.lost: Sold to the rivals. Don't worry, the real game lets you try again against 9 AI franchises.

drift.brief: This is RepoMind's real output on its ShopWise demo repo. Drag through the history, then stop at the commit where the architecture first broke.

points.note: The sales report reads the order repository directly.

points.commit: Move the sales report into ReportService
points.note: Fixed a week later. Health is back to 100.

points.commit: Live stock level on the product page
points.note: A router calls a repository again.
Two violations are still in the code today.

drift.right: That's it: a rushed hotfix, a skipped layer. RepoMind found the same commit from the graph.
drift.wrong: Not that one. Look for the first drop from 100.

clipper.brief: Clipper scored 8 moments in a real 20-minute interview. Pick the one you think scored highest.
clipper.reveal: The model called a friendly cricket chat "A Disturbing Realization". The transcript was so garbled that the scores couldn't be trusted, so this run counts as a failure. Better transcription lifted word confidence from 58% to 78%. No one has yet judged the clips by watching them.

mimic.brief: I'm hiding in this room, disguised as furniture. You have 3 shots. Watch for something that blinks.
misses: In the real game, shooting a decoy costs you double.
mimic.found: Found me! In the real game a whole mansion hides players like this, and the server never tells a Hunter where a hider is unless they could see them.
mimic.lost: Out of shots. I was the lamp all along. Hunters lose a lot of rounds like this one.

solvefx.brief: It's 2 AM and my Two Sum is on trial. Drive through all three test cases, in order, before the time limit.
solvefx.hint: Follow the arrow. A wall is a wrong answer.
solvefx.won: Accepted in {time} seconds. SolveFX gives every verdict its own overlay and sound, so the whole hostel hears about it.
solvefx.lost: Time limit exceeded. SolveFX answers this verdict with a fake system shutdown.

ipl-auction.brief: You're bidding for me against three rival franchises. Drive through the paddles to raise your bid. The hammer falls in 25 seconds.

repomind-ai.brief: A rushed hotfix just let the sales report skip a layer. That's architecture drift, and it's getting away. Catch it.
repomind-ai.label: DRIFT
repomind-ai.commit: 27 Mar · Hotfix: sales report for finance
repomind-ai.won: Caught on 27 Mar: the sales report read the order repository directly. RepoMind flags the same commit from its graph.
repomind-ai.lost: It got away. In the real demo repo the drift came back, and two violations are still in the code today.

clipper.brief: Clipper scored moments in a real 20-minute interview. Three roads, three moments. Drive down the one you think scored highest.
clipper.hint: Each road is one moment Clipper found.

clipper.reveal: The twist: it called a friendly cricket chat “A Disturbing Realization”. The transcript was too garbled to trust, so this run counts as a failure.
